segments.sn11.2:2.2: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo susīmaṃ [susimaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] devaputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn11.2:2.5: ‘Evaṃ bhaddantavā’ti kho, bhikkhave, susīmo devaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā pamādaṃ āpādesi.
segments.sn11.2:2.6: Dutiyampi kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo susīmaṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi … pe … dutiyampi pamādaṃ āpādesi.
segments.sn11.2:2.8: Tatiyampi kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo susīmaṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi … pe … tatiyampi pamādaṃ āpādesi.
segments.sn11.2:2.10: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo susīmaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn11.2:3.3: Susīma tattha gacchāhi, mañca tattheva pāpayā”ti.
segments.sn11.2:4.3: Sabbakāmasamiddhassa, taṃ me sakka varaṃ disā”ti.
segments.sn11.2:5.3: Susīma tattha gacchāhi, mañca tattheva pāpayā”ti.
segments.sn11.2:6.3: Asokaṃ anupāyāsaṃ, taṃ me sakka varaṃ disā”ti.
segments.sn11.2:7.1: “Sace atthi akammena, koci kvaci na jīvati;
segments.sn11.2:7.3: Nibbānassa hi so maggo, susīma tattha gacchāhi;
segments.sn11.2:8.1: “So hi nāma, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo sakaṃ puññaphalaṃ upajīvamāno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kārento uṭṭhānavīriyassa vaṇṇavādī bhavissati.
segments.sn11.2:8.2: Idha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, sobhetha, yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā uṭṭhaheyyātha ghaṭeyyātha vāyameyyātha appattassa pattiyā, anadhigatassa adhigamāya, asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti.

lines: Dutiye susīmanti attano puttasahassassa antare evaṃnāmakaṃ ekaṃ puttameva.
